label: Binary, thermometer and segmented
subgoals: Count N elements for binary weighting
Count two to the N minus one elements for thermometer coding
Count two to the M minus one plus N minus M for segmentation

label: DNL and INL from measured levels
section: DNL and INL from measured levels
subgoals: Compute the endpoint LSB from the span
Divide each step by the LSB and subtract one for DNL
Read a DNL of minus one as a missing code

label: Mismatch and the major-carry transition
subgoals: Assign each unit element an independent relative error
Count the units that change at the mid-scale transition
Add their variances to get sigma times the root of two to the N minus one
